facts.name: the request's tail jump into BattleLeader_CycleSwitch
facts.note: FieldCommandCtrl_RequestLeaderCycleSwitch's E9 to the cycle, right after mov r8b,1 (require CanSwitch) and add rsp,28h: 1.004 E9 58 00 00 00 at %16=11, 1.005 E9 4C 0B 75 00 at %16=3; both inside one block. The function is the same four steps in both builds (the event counters' refusal, then the jump).
